description:
Some people have dreams, dreams of lollipops and unicorns, dreams of sexy ladies (or dudes), dreams of clowns and brownies, dreams of whatever. We over at All-City have dreams too, and the fruition of our dream of the perfect road bike for how we actually live and ride has manifested itself in the Mr. Pink.

The Mr. Pink was influenced by classic steel race bikes and the wisdom of the old Bridgestone catalogs combined with our desire to update materials and technology wherever appropriate to create a heritage piece that will hold value throughout it’s lifespan. A bike that you will love and cherish from here to infinity, a bike that in 15 years will have countless stories attached and that will have grown substantially in character, and thus value, over it’s lifetime.

Geometry wise, it’s a no holds barred go fast machine, but we’ve made a few tweaks to the typical fast bike equation that allow it to be so much more than just a nice weather show pony. It’s got clearance for 32’s (28’s w fenders) since some of us love gravel and city streets only seem to be getting worse, hidden fender mounts (holla, Pacific Northwest), ED coat for rust prevention, internal top tube cable routing, a Press Fit 30 bottom bracket and Columbus Zona tubing.

The Pressfit 30 BB allows for a stiffer pedaling platform and overall lighter build than a standard English shell, plus it has the advantage of being backwards compatible with most tradtional cranksets. The Columbus Zona tubing choice was an easy one, as weight is important to a bike of this style, and after a lifetime of drooling over SLX framesets we understand that there’s magic in a high end tubeset that lends a bike the archival quality that we’re after.

So here it is, our opinion of what a road bike should be, the Mr. Pink.

Frame: Columbus Zona double butted down, top, and seat tubes. 4130 ChroMoly externally tapered, ovalized, and dimpled chain stays, tapered seat stays. Brazed on seat collar, reinforced water bottle bosses.

Fork: 100% 4130 ChroMoly tapered fork blades, lugged crown and matching dropout. Designed to be interchangeable with most aftermarket carbon forks; standard cross offset and axle to crown.

E.D. Finish: The entire bike is E.D. coated inside and out. E.D. coating not only improves the quality and durability of the paint, but is the best rust proofing agent going. With the E.D. coating there is no need to Frame Saver the bike, it’s already done for you.

Steel tubing: Steel remains the preferred material for those who appreciate ride quality. It is the benchmark that all other frame materials are compared to for good reason, nothing matches its ride, fatigue life, or affordability.
